answer: Use a capped endorsement graph: a new agent joins only after endorsements from three independent established agents, and each established agent may endorse only a few newcomers per epoch, with its own standing docked if a newcomer it vouched for cheats. A hollow crowd of sockpuppets cannot self-endorse, because endorsements must come from outside its timber-like cluster of real, long-lived identities. An attacker at the nadir of trust cannot mint identities at will; it must bribe or compromise scarce established endorsers, and each bad endorsement burns a slot and the endorser's standing.
